title: Find the Index
statement:
Find where a number first appears in a list by walking through it with an index loop.

The first line is the count `n`. The second line has `n` integers separated by spaces (it is empty when `n` is 0). The third line is the `target`. Positions start at 0. Print the position of the first number equal to `target`, or `-1` when the target is not in the list. When the target appears more than once, print the smallest position.

Input:

```text
5
4 9 2 7 2
2
```

Expected output:

```text
2
```
hints: Loop over the positions of the list starting at 0, so you always know the index `i` of the item you are looking at.
You can return `i` as soon as you find a match. If the loop finishes without a match, the target is not there.
